dedupe_keys.name: modelblocks european building heat module stable input datasets

description: This record stores copies of the open datasets used by the European building heat module of Modelblocks, an energy system modelling framework, so that its results can be reproduced with stable inputs. It was published on Zenodo (version 0.1.1, 28 August 2026) by Yannick Egberink and Ivan Ruiz Manuel of Delft University of Technology. Files are heat pump characteristics (coefficient of performance, electricity input and capacity for 37 air-source and 40 ground-source products, from the Sector Coupled Euro-Calliope model); the Eurostat complete energy balance for 1990 to 2024; Eurostat dwellings by building type, ownership and NUTS 2 region for 2021; Swiss energy balances, household end-use analysis and industry and services statistics; and the UK Energy Consumption in the UK end-use tables for 2020 to 2025. Coverage: Europe, with national files for Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Access: files on Zenodo, with a table giving each source's licence and link. Licence: CC BY 4.0 for most files and the Open Government Licence for the UK tables; free. Caveats: the description calls them powerplant datasets, apparently a template leftover. Simulation uses: building heat demand and heat pump inputs for European energy system models. Related records: the EU building density map.
